items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: when I was a young man, first getting with Harold Dejan and so forth, so they would give us music to read.

ctx.x: And have a real professional attitude about it.

That's right, that's right. That was the difference in a lot of brass bands too. There were those brass bands that could read, they read. You had to, when you were, when I was a young man, first getting with Harold Dejan and so forth, so they would give us music to read. With no titles on it or nothing. They just said number 31. Well I have to know that, after I got it into my head I knew 31 was a funeral march. And a very popular one that you played on the street. And they'd pass out music to the men, you see.…
